dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Trailing edge exhibits a moderately concave curvature from the posterior base leading toward the apex.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Rounded shape classification with a wide pixel radius at the fin's highest morphological point.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Steep positive slope approximately 55 degrees relative to the horizontal body axis.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Approximate 1.7:1 ratio of maximum base width to maximum vertical height.

anterior_cranial_contour.melon_arc_radius: Smooth, broad convexity visible on the anterior-dorsal boundary of the cranium.
anterior_cranial_contour.rostrum_aspect_vector: Relatively short and robust rostrum extending from the melon inflection point toward the anterior tip.
anterior_cranial_contour.cranial_inflection_angle: Obtuse interior angle measured at the pixel junction where the melon slope meets the rostrum.

other_distinctive_markers: Prominent, wide-span caudal flukes with a distinct median notch; uniform dark teal-green pigmentation across the entire visible surface.
